description: Hook points fired by aos-mcp: aos tools called through it (the CLI's own tools do not pass here). The agent family's rules (aos.agentlib.hooks, in code; this file only tells): exit 10 blocks a point with block true; on a point with output, exit 0 and a JSON object on stdout replace those keys; condition names the field a hookeds entry's condition is compared with (only for these tool names / error codes); a failing hook stops a point with block true and is one warning elsewhere. A hook that stops before_tool / after_tool makes that tool call an error result; the agent goes on.

before_tool.description: before an aos tool called through aos-mcp runs

stack.description: the agent's stack (the handler's own AOS_STACK is STACK/hookeds/NAME/)

id.description: the JSON-RPC id as a string (empty when none)

arguments.description: the arguments the tool will get

output.description: exit 0 with a JSON object on stdout: these keys replace the event's

before_tool.subject: tool
before_tool.if_blocked: the tool does not run; the CLI gets the hook's stdout (or a default line) as the result

after_tool.description: an aos tool called through aos-mcp finished (not for a blocked tool)

stack.description: the agent's stack (the handler's own AOS_STACK is STACK/hookeds/NAME/)

id.description: the JSON-RPC id as a string (empty when none)

content.description: all text parts joined into one

code.description: the tool's exit code, null when it timed out

output.description: exit 0 with a JSON object on stdout: these keys replace the event's

after_tool.subject: tool
